policy.title: Employee reimbursement policy
policy.source: Local JSON; written clauses and structured rules are manually authored together
policy.interpretation: The demo uses human-maintained structured rules alongside written policy. It does not automatically extract policy rules from natural language.

clauses.text: Every reimbursement must include a receipt. Automatic routing applies only to ordinary, non-exception reimbursements.
Every ordinary reimbursement requires approval from the employee's manager and the finance team. These are the only required approvals for an amount of $1,000 or less.
A reimbursement greater than $1,000 also requires department head approval. Department head approval is not required for amounts of $1,000 or less.
A reimbursement greater than $5,000 also requires CFO approval. CFO approval is not required for amounts of $5,000 or less.

An exception or a missing receipt requires manual review. Retain all current approval steps until an authorized reviewer resolves the issue; this demo must not recommend removing controls or claim time savings in these cases.

workflow.name: Employee reimbursement
workflow.description: The current fictional workflow sends every expense through four sequential approvals, regardless of amount.
